2609.00065.title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
2609.00065.paper_summary: A language-model agent asked to analyse an experiment will usually return working code. Whether the analysis is defensible is a different question. A defensible analysis depends on procedural choices: which test the field accepts, which identifier namespace is authoritative, and which caveats must accompany a result. We present Scientific Agent Skills, an open library of 163 such procedures in 16 areas of practice, including genomics, cheminformatics, medical imaging, study design and scientific communication. Each skill is a directory built around a versioned, human-readable instruction file. An agent loads the file only when a task calls for it; the directory often also contains reference material and runnable scripts. We report no task-level evaluation and no host selection rate. We measure two properties of the documentation corpus: the always-resident descriptions of all 163 skills cost 7.1% of a 200,000-token window, and the median documented workflow fits within 23.9% of it, although 29 of 46 would overflow if every reference file were loaded. Openly licensed and available at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.
2609.00065.paper_summary_zh: 一個被要求分析實驗的語言模型代理通常會返回可運行的代碼。分析是否合理是另一個問題。合理的分析取決於程序選擇：該領域接受哪種測試、哪個標識符命名空間是權威的，以及結果必須伴隨哪些警告。我們介紹了科學代理技能，這是一個開放的庫，包含16個實踐領域中的163種程序，包括基因組學、化學信息學、醫學影像、研究設計和科學交流。每項技能都是圍繞一個版本化的人類可讀指令文件構建的目錄。代理僅在任務需要時加載該文件；目錄通常還包含參考材料和可運行的腳本。我們報告沒有任務級別的評估和沒有主機選擇率。我們測量文檔語料庫的兩個屬性：所有163項技能的常駐描述佔用200,000個標記窗口的7.1%，而中位數的文檔工作流程則適合其中的23.9%，儘管如果每個參考文件都被加載，46個中的29個將會溢出。該庫是開放授權的，並可在https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills獲得。
